goal: Allow users spending Taproot descriptors to skip script-path signing and metadata via a keypath_only option
Avoid leaking fallback scripts, wasting transaction fees, and risking accidental fallback spends
agreement: Broad agreement on motivation with all feedback resolved
Support because skipping fallback scripts saves fees and improves privacy (rkrux, jeanpablojp)
Verified by running the touched tests and checking keypath signing behavior (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it adds an opt-in parameter for advanced Taproot setups like MuSig2 with timelocked fallback scripts
Saves on-chain fees, prevents privacy leaks, and avoids triggering external signer bugs on fallback paths
